items.summary: US job openings unexpectedly jumped in September to a four-month high and layoffs fell to the lowest level in over a year, signaling firmer demand for workers heading into the fourth quarter.

items.title: Las Vegas Raiders owner Mark Davis says he feels no pressure to rush backup QB Fernando Mendoza
items.summary: Las Vegas Raiders owner Mark Davis says he feels no pressure to rush backup quarterback Fernando Mendoza onto the field.
items.title_ko: Las Vegas Raiders의 소유주인 Mark Davis는 백업 QB Fernando Mendoza를 서두를 필요가 없다고 말했습니다.

items.title: CFTC clears perpetual futures on stocks, bringing crypto trading model to Wall Street
items.summary: CFTC Chair Michael Selig said the move gives U.S. traders a regulated alternative to “offshore, and often unregulated, venues.”
